families.proofObligation1: one entry check per unit plus one per CHECK_EVERY nodes of a counter that spans the units: the check count of a scope is NOT a function of its footprint alone, but its node increment is; the checks are replayed from the cached increment and the incoming residue (floor((r+inc)/CHECK_EVERY) - floor(r/CHECK_EVERY))
families.proofObligation2: nothing reads the scratch of an interrupted scan (tech-subset.js re-initialises it by every find and unit, and no handler wraps a subset finder: the only handler that swallows budget.exceeded is tech-chain.js, inside its own find); a negative is recorded only after a completed scan, never when a check threw
